description: We are a student team from India building EarthPulse - an AI-based dashboard to detect Earth temperature and rainfall trends using NASA open data. We will visualize past trends and predict future trends using simple Machine Learning. Our goal is to make climate data easy to understand for everyone. Looking for 1-2 team members interested in coding, data and design.
summary: EarthPulse is a simple AI-based dashboard built for the challenge "Be An Earth System Trend Detective!". It uses NASA open Earth data for Kanpur, India to detect long-term trends in temperature and rainfall. Our tool visualizes the last 20 years of data with clear graphs and uses Linear Regression, a basic Machine Learning model, to predict the average temperature for 2030. The goal is to make complex NASA climate data easy to understand for students, farmers and common people, so they can see how their own city is changing. The project is built with Python, Pandas, Matplotlib and Streamlit.
details:
What does it do?

EarthPulse takes NASA POWER open data for temperature and rainfall for Kanpur, India, cleans it and shows trends over time.

How does it work?

1. We download yearly average temperature and rainfall data from NASA POWER.

2. We use Python Pandas to clean the data.

3. We plot trends using Matplotlib / Streamlit charts.

4. We train a Linear Regression model on Year vs Temperature to predict temperature for 2025-2030.

Tools used: Python, Pandas, Scikit-learn (Linear Regression), Matplotlib, Streamlit, NASA POWER Data, Google Slides for demo.

Impact: A student or farmer can open the dashboard and in 1 minute understand - "Mere sheher ka temperature badh raha hai ya nahi?" This makes NASA data useful for local decisions.

Creativity: Instead of showing raw data, we convert it into a simple story - Past Trend + Future Prediction + One-line conclusion in simple language.
